Package org.tasktide.engine.policies

Class AbstractAcquisitionPolicy

java.lang.Object
org.tasktide.engine.policies.AbstractAcquisitionPolicy
All Implemented Interfaces:
TaskTideWorkloadAcquisitionPolicy
Direct Known Subclasses:
TargetedAcquisitionPolicy, WorkflowAcquisitionPolicy
public abstract class AbstractAcquisitionPolicy extends Object implements TaskTideWorkloadAcquisitionPolicy
Abstract implementation of TaskTideWorkloadAcquisitionPolicy to take the field policy building, and field getter aspects. Preserves generic TaskTideModel type to allow implementing class to focus on the specifics of building/fetching the required TaskTideModel collection
